items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: them guys like Dave Payton, Fletcher Henderson, them guys used to write stuff for them boys

ctx.x: Did the white trumpet players play about the same as the colored? Yeah.

Not way back, but now lately they are. On them way back there years ago, they couldn't get it, you know. For some reason they couldn't get it, but by them guys, you know, writing, like in Chicago anyway, them guys like Dave Payton, Fletcher Henderson, them guys used to write stuff for them boys, see. And they started getting that up. They couldn't read the music. Oh, they want to get that text, you know, that right text. Well, they made it so mechanical. Yeah, that's what I'm talking about. You can't feel it,…
But I wondered, would they bend notes and stuff like that most times? Would they use a growl or anything, the white trumpet players like that?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Yeah, I worked with him at the Regal Theater when it first opened up.

ctx.x: What about Dave Payton? Did you ever work with him?
Yeah, I worked with him at the Regal Theater when it first opened up. Mm-hmm.
And who, which other bands were you working with while you were working with Dave Payton?
